rows.role_title: National Convenor of the Aam Aadmi Party
rows.text: The party's letter of 31 May 2016 to the Election Commission says the new National Executive 'in its 1st meeting on 27th April has elected new office bearers of the party', and the enclosed certified excerpt of the National Executive's minutes of 27 April 2016 records that it 'ELECTED THE FOLLOWING PERSONS AS OFFICE BEARER OF THE PARTY W.E.F. 27.04.2016', the first being 'ARVIND KEJRIWAL – NATIONAL CONVENER'.
